name: SEO Anchor Class Tracker
author: Ultralink It Solution LLP

sections.description:
This plugin buffers the fully rendered front-end HTML of your site and appends a unique class to every tag — including links in menus, widgets, headers, footers, and post content, not just the main content area.

Configure everything under Settings > SEO Link Classes:

  • Class prefix
  • Hash length
  • Uniqueness mode: same class per destination URL (recommended for analytics), or a brand-new class for every single link occurrence
  • Skip rules for empty/# /javascript: links
  • An opt-out class you can add to any link or wrapping element
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the zip directly via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin.
  3. Go to Settings > SEO Link Classes to configure.
  4. If you use a full-page cache plugin, clear the cache after activating or changing settings.

short_description: Adds unique dynamic CSS classes to front-end links for SEO and analytics tracking without modifying existing classes or markup.
